Absolute Kinetics Consultancy (AKC) Pte Ltd officially opened for business on 18th April 2001.

AKC is an Approved Training Organisation appointed by SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) to provide a wide range of courses approved by Ministry of Manpower (MOM), SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), Singapore Resuscitation and First Aid Council (SRFAC), & Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF).

Its clientele list includes SMEs to MNCs from various industrials ranging from construction, manufacturing, oil & gas to employment firms (Certificate of Employment Intermediaries for Key Appointment Holders & General Employees). The company is also an approved MOM SIP (Settling in Programme for Foreign Domestic Workers) training center and an approved Food Safety training provider.

AKC conducts workplace and health safety courses as its core business and also offers consultancy, risk management and other specialised training services such as certificate for employment intermediaries. It also has a team of around 100 professionals (comprising full time and part time trainers) skilled in various safety specialisations such as construction safety, scaffolding, shipyard safety, metalworking and welding, amongst others.

title: Social Media Account Executive
description:
What You'll Be Doing

As our Social Media Account Executive, you'll manage social media campaigns and client retainer accounts, overseeing content delivery, account performance, and client satisfaction. Here's what your responsibilities will include:

  • Content Production: Turn concepts into reality by executing basic production tasks and capturing simple social content.
  • Designer & Editor Collaboration: Work with designers and video editors to bring the creative vision to life through clear communication and direction.
  • Client Communication: Build strong client relationships by understanding their briefs, presenting concepts persuasively, and executing the plans effectively.
  • Client Brand Management: Manage the clients’ social media accounts, monthly content production, reports and community management.
  • Support New Business Pitches:  Assist in crafting pitch proposals by developing sample social media content to demonstrate capabilities and secure new client accounts.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyse social performance data to identify trends and generate insights that improve future campaigns.
  • Content Calendar Management: Create and maintain content calendars to keep campaigns organized and ensure deadlines are met with quality work.
  • Platform & Trend Monitoring: Stay ahead of social media trends and platform changes to identify new opportunities for clients.

Who You Are

  • Someone who understands both the art and science of social media content creation
  • A hands-on creator who can produce simple content while directing more complex production
  • A detail-oriented professional who values data-informed decision making
  • A collaborative team player who works effectively with designers, editors, and clients
  • A person who can manage multiple projects simultaneously without compromising quality
  • Someone who stays current with social media trends and platform changes

Skills & Experience We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in social media account management and content creation, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating successful social media campaigns across multiple platforms
  • Proficiency with content creation tools (like AdobeCreative Suite, Canva, CapCut) and social media management platforms
  • Strong understanding of social media analytics and data interpretation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for effective client presentations
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, DigitalMedia, or related field (or equivalent experience)

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience with social media community management and crisis response
  • Knowledge of paid social media advertising strategies
  • Background in influencer marketing campaigns
  • Understanding of SEO principles as they apply to social content

Why Join Us?

  • Work with diverse clients across various industries to expand your portfolio
  • Collaborative environment that values fresh ideas and strategic thinking
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development opportunities to keep enhancing your skills
  • A culture that balances professionalism with personality—we take our work seriously, not ourselves
